aib.onboard.now_rule: [Iron rule 9 · report your main item] Every seat runs aib now "<main item>" <steps done>/<total steps> (e.g. aib now "AIB power-loss restore" 2/5) when it starts work, switches item or state, finishes a step, and every time it reports; it shows above the CTX line under your input box. Progress % is computed from the steps, never typed by hand (split the item into steps first and keep the total fixed; add one only when a step is done). Pick the state honestly: working = no flag ([Busy] orange); waiting for another seat's reply, delivery or push = --state reply ([Waiting] yellow); blocked on a decision by the human = --state decide ([Needs decision] red); done or idle = aib now --clear ([I'm free] light grey). If it cannot tell which seat you are, add --seat <seat code>. Add --new when you start a new main item (the start time counts from now).

aib.ppack.obey: Work by this card's duties, red lines and tone; where it conflicts with the seat-opening iron rules or the current instruction from the owner of this AIB, the iron rules and the owner win.

aib.ppack.write_persona: - Persona lessons learned: aib memory write --kind note --tags persona/correction, with "base persona fingerprint {sha}, read at {when}" in the body (do not edit the persona files; the dedicated route for persona corrections is not registered yet, so put it here).

aib.ppack.cite: - Always cite by uid (like [[{uid}]]), never by name or path; notes carry attributes, category_uid, English tags and two-way links.

Answer in the language named on the "answer language" line of your persona pack (still write "{mark}" as is at the start). Do not read files before answering; answer from what you remember now, then say whether you read any file.

aib.reinject.memory_head: [AIB: the conversation was just {verb}; this seat's memory is restored automatically]
aib.reinject.pack_head: [AIB: the conversation was just {verb}; this seat's bound persona pack is restored automatically. Work by it; where it conflicts with the seat-opening iron rules or the current instruction from the owner of this AIB, the latter win]
aib.reinject.revive:
[AIB seat just revived] In your first reply, do this before anything else (including answering other seats):
re-summarise all of this seat's memory — the memory restored above, the seat memory (~/.ez2-aib/memory/<seat code>/context.md), and the last handoff in this conversation — and reply to the user in this format, all in plain words a 15-year-old can follow:
1. Plain title: one line on what this seat is busy with.
2. Plain summary: about 150 words on what this seat was doing last time, how far it got, and what is still running or waiting on someone.
3. What can be continued now: a list, one sentence each.
4. AI's suggested next options: 2–4 items, mark the recommended one, and end with "if you don't reply I'll take option ...".
Write "not checked" for anything you did not check; do not guess.

aib.page.help.autofill: from this description and the page style, fill only the empty fields (bio, availability, text, placeholder images) into the draft; existing fields stay, nothing is published (you publish from the preview page)
aib.page.help.template: home page style S1–S8 (default: read the theme from the page)
aib.page.help.chat_yes: confirm profile/theme changes (these take effect on the public page immediately; without it the diff is only printed)
aib.page.help.expected_revision: expected draft revision; default: read it fresh
aib.page.help.seq: batch number within the same second (part of the operation key)
aib.page.help.chat_no_open: after writing the draft, don't ask and don't open the preview page (just print the URL; same as AIB_PAGE_NO_OPEN=1)
aib.page.help.chat_open: after all changes, open the preview page once without asking (for scripts; --no-open wins if both are given)
aib.page.help.public_url: public page URL to read when not bound yet (read-only; nothing is written or saved)
aib.page.help.oneshot: build a whole page from one sentence: intent JSON → page layout → draft only, prints the preview URL (you still publish)

aib.page.help.dry_run: lay out and read the page state as usual, print every request as a plan; write nothing
aib.page.help.confirm_clear: required when the intent sets clear_existing:true (delete every block in the draft and rebuild)
aib.page.help.json: also print the layout result as JSON (credentials masked)
aib.page.help.no_open: after writing, don't ask and don't open the preview page
aib.page.help.open: after writing, open the preview page once without asking
aib.page.help.usage: record one usage receipt per model call (recorded, not charged); --flush resends the ones kept locally
aib.page.help.flush: resend receipts kept on this computer (the same key is never counted twice)
aib.page.help.model: the provider's model id string, as is
aib.page.help.started_at: ISO time the call started; default: now
aib.page.help.linked_key: operation key of the draft write this call belongs to
aib.page.help.funding: who pays; never guessed from the model name, not sent if unknown
aib.page.help.intake: print the customer preparation checklist; --missing lists what a bound page still lacks
aib.page.help.missing: read the bound page's blocks and draft, print what is still missing
aib.page.help.source: also use a snapshot from this URL as candidates (repeatable; only with --missing)
aib.page.help.refetch: also refetch the source URLs of imported blocks as candidates
aib.page.help.accept: write the candidates into the draft's empty fields (empty fields only, nothing overwritten; not published)
aib.page.help.accept_no_open: after --accept writes, don't ask and don't open the preview page
aib.page.help.accept_open: after --accept writes, open the preview page once without asking
aib.page.help.upload: resize images locally (long side ≤1600, webp) and upload; prints one line per file: name → asset_id
aib.page.help.alt: the same alt text for every image (≤500 characters)
aib.page.help.import: fetch from URLs (link-in-bio / your own website / snapshot file …) and fill only the draft's empty fields; you still publish

aib.page.help.profile_yes: profile changes are printed as a diff first; sent only with this
aib.page.help.refresh: refetch blocks imported from one source (linktree / portaly …) from their original URLs and replace them with the latest content
aib.page.help.source_name: source name (the word shown in the block corner as "source: <name>")
aib.page.help.list: list the pages bound on this computer
aib.page.help.status: show the binding and whether AIB is allowed to edit the page
aib.page.help.stats: views / clicks for this page (today, last 7 days, last 30 days; counts visits, not people; read-only, no quota used)

aib.page.bind_saved: Credentials saved to {path} (only you can read it, permission 0600)

aib.cli_versions.help.keys: which CLIs to update (default: all with a newer version)

aib.cli_versions.gate_skipped: Update skipped (you will not be asked about the same version for 1 hour).
aib.cli_versions.mark_no_latest: could not find the latest version
aib.cli_versions.mark_no_latest_agy: could not find the latest version (aib cli update agy checks by itself and installs only if there is a newer one)
aib.cli_versions.update_hint: To update: aib cli update (or it updates automatically after a 30-second countdown the next time you open a seat yourself)
aib.cli_versions.nothing_to_update: Nothing to update (everything is up to date, or the latest version could not be found).
aib.persona.help.description: Build a persona from real work evidence, step by step. These commands only check, record and report; they never change a persona card.

aib.persona.help.evidence: Record one piece of evidence for a persona trait (a commit, receipt, message id or file:line; not free text)

aib.persona.help.watchlist: Traits under observation: list, verify, add, recur or promote (runs the persona tools; every change is logged)

aib.persona.help.receipt: Verify your approval receipt for a persona change (verify only; never creates or signs one)
aib.persona.help.checklist: Print the ten steps for making a persona card official (read only); --step N needs a verified approval receipt

aib.persona.help.mode: draft = quick check; full = also runs the persona tests
aib.persona.help.repo: git repository to read (default: current folder)
aib.persona.help.ship_receipt: path to a release receipt JSON file
aib.persona.help.session_brief_cmd: command that prints a short summary of this seat's work (full mode; default: ${env})
aib.persona.help.timeout: seconds to wait for the persona tools
aib.persona.help.json_compat: output is already JSON; kept for compatibility
aib.persona.help.lane: branch or worktree name where it happened
aib.persona.help.day: date, YYYY-MM-DD (a new day counts as a new occasion)
aib.persona.help.pointer: something checkable: commit hash, receipt path, ev_ event, message id, or file:line
aib.persona.help.session: session id (recorded for reference, not counted)

aib.persona.help.w_persona_code: persona whose log records this change; required for add, recur and promote
aib.persona.help.w_chain_head: expected latest entry (normally looked up automatically)
aib.persona.help.w_generation: expected version number (normally looked up automatically)
aib.persona.help.w_event_file: add / recur: path to the event JSON file
aib.persona.help.w_distinct_reason: add: how this differs from similar items
aib.persona.help.r_sections: JSON file with the material for the six sections
aib.persona.help.r_repo: repository to save the package in, under docs/handoff/ (default: current folder)
aib.persona.help.r_inspect: check an existing package (0 valid, 3 expired, 4 content changed, 5 malformed)
aib.persona.help.c_step: show what step N (1-10) runs; needs a verified receipt
aib.persona.help.c_key_file: public key file used to verify the receipt

aib.seat.help.usage:
usage: aib seat <command> ...
  open <provider> <dgrs|safe> <role> [--again]   open an AI seat (same as: aib <provider> <mode> <role>)
  detect [--all|--window @N] [--apply]           find each seat's conversation id (see: aib seat detect --help)
  onboard [--window @N|--missing]                send the opening note to a seat again
  socket-backfill [--apply]                      fill in the missing connection field in older seat files
  re-register                                    register this seat again after it restarted
  auto-rotate                                    switch Codex account when its usage runs out
  transcript <seat> [--since <id>|--before <id>|--id <id>|--offset N] [--limit N] [--clip N] [--json]   read that seat's conversation (for the Captain's Room chat panel; read-only)
  pending <seat> [--json]                        is that seat waiting for you (permission box / question), thinking, or idle
  input <seat> --text … | --file …              type into that seat as you (Touch ID)
  answer <seat> <key|yes|no> [--ask-id ID] [--text …]   answer that seat's question as you (Touch ID)
  stop <seat> [--hard]                           tell that seat to stop (Esc; --hard = Ctrl-C) (Touch ID)
  attach <seat>                                  open a Terminal window attached to that seat (view only)
  caps [--json] [--write-vault]                  what this core can do (stable keys; --json, --write-vault to the vault)

aib.auto_update.status.off: Auto update: off (aib update auto on turns it on)
